questions.text: Answer any seven questions of the following :

sub_questions.text: Show $\delta(at) = \frac{1}{|a|} \delta(t)$ where $\delta(t)$ is an impulse function.
Draw the time waveform of the signal $x(t) = u(t-3) - u(t-6)$
Determine the fundamental period of the signal $x(t) = j e^{j10t}$.
If $E_x$ is the energy of the signal $x(t)$, determine the energy of the signal $x(at-b)$ in terms of $E_x$.
If $x_1(t)$ and $x_2(t)$ are odd and even signals respectively, determine whether the signal $x_1(t) x_2(t)$ would be even or odd signal.
Determine whether the system described by $y(t) = x(2t)$ is causal.
A system is described by the input-output relationship $y(n) = \text{Re}[x(n)]$. Determine whether the corresponding system is linear, where $\text{Re}[x(n)]$ represents the real part of $x(n)$.
Determine whether the system described by $y(t) = \frac{d}{dt} u(t)$ is stable or not.
Sketch the time waveform of the signal $x(t) = \frac{d}{dt} [u(t-4) - u(t-7)]$
